hooks.text: Apollo astronauts saw bright flashes right through their closed eyelids.
Why did Apollo astronauts see bright light in complete darkness?
Apollo astronauts closed their eyelids and saw light blinding them.

title: Why Apollo Astronauts Saw Flashes in Total Darkness
description: Apollo astronauts closing their eyes in deep space saw mysterious light flashes slicing through darkness, caused by high-energy cosmic rays penetrating their eyes.

beats.text: Apollo astronauts saw bright flashes right through their closed eyelids.
beats.visual: Apollo astronaut sleeping in Command Module hammock

beats.text: On Earth, closing your eyes blocks out every trace of light.
beats.visual: Pitch black starry background representing darkness on Earth

beats.text: In deep space, astronauts trying to sleep kept seeing white streaks.
beats.visual: Apollo Command and Service Module in translunar coast
queries: Apollo Command Module deep space photo

beats.text: Invisible cosmic rays were blasting straight through the spacecraft hull.
beats.visual: Illustration of cosmic ray particle passing through human eye

beats.text: The high-energy particles passed right through their skulls into their retinas.
beats.visual: Diagram showing cosmic radiation penetrating human skull and retina

beats.text: Direct radiation turned their eyes into particle detectors.
beats.visual: Close-up diagram of human retinal cells stimulated by radiation

beats.text: NASA tested this with ALFMED, a helmet lined with radiation plates.
beats.visual: ALFMED helmet device worn during Apollo 16 light flash experiment

beats.text: The recorded particle tracks matched the exact seconds astronauts saw light.
beats.visual: Apollo 16 Command Module interior showing ALFMED apparatus
